question: Which New England banking organizations with $5B-$50B in assets have the highest CRE concentration relative to capital, 2026Q2?
headline: Northeast Bank has the highest CRE concentration among New England banking organizations with $5B-$50B in assets in 2026Q2, at 485.61% of total risk-based capital.
insights: Five organizations are above the 300% supervisory guideline: Northeast Bank (485.61%), Cambridge Financial Group (348.30%), Beacon Financial Corp (335.68%), Washington Trust Bancorp (334.12%) and NB Bancorp (314.41%). The guideline is a flag for closer review, not a limit.
Liberty Financial Corp (299.50%) sits just below 300%. Independent Bank Corp (MA) is at 277.66% and Eastern Bankshares at 261.13%, both below the peer aggregate.
The group aggregate is 275.44%. The lowest are Mutual Bancorp (108.40%), IFS 1820 Bancorp (128.12%) and Middlesex Bancorp (196.01%).
These are bank-level ratios (regulatory CRE excluding owner-occupied, divided by total risk-based capital), so they run above the holding companies' own disclosed ratios.
